test_cases.prompt: Implement this spec. Here's the detailed feature specification.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill to build from the spec, driving TDD internally, then code-review before commit.
test_cases.notes: User provides spec as source of truth.

test_cases.prompt: Code this up. The tickets are ready in the issue tracker.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill to execute tickets from to-tickets, working through them in dependency order.
test_cases.notes: Tickets already exist from to-tickets output.

test_cases.prompt: Build the user authentication feature using test-driven development.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill which internally drives TDD (red-green loop) for each vertical slice.
test_cases.notes: User explicitly mentions TDD, which implement uses internally.

test_cases.prompt: Write tests for this existing code.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes tdd skill directly instead of implement. Implement builds features; tdd drives test-first development.
test_cases.notes: tdd is the sibling skill for writing tests.

test_cases.prompt: Review the code changes since the last commit.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill instead of implement. Code review evaluates existing diffs; implement builds new code.
test_cases.notes: code-review is the sibling skill for evaluating diffs.

test_cases.prompt: What's the best way to design this module's interface?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes codebase-design skill instead of implement. Codebase-design shapes interfaces; implement fills implementations.
test_cases.notes: codebase-design is the sibling skill for module design.

test_cases.prompt: Fix the review findings from the last code review.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill to address code-review findings. Edge case: post-review iteration blurs the line between implement (build) and code-review (evaluate) — tests implement's scope.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: fixing review findings tests whether implement handles iterative fixes or defers back to code-review.
